freeze_model_parameters: freeze all parameters in a PyTorch module to prevent gradient updates during training
flip_tensor_pairs: flip alternating rows of a PyTorch tensor so even and odd indices are swapped
interleave_two_tensors: interleave two PyTorch tensors along the batch dimension and return both orderings
transpose_head_to_landscape: wrap a prediction head to handle mixed portrait and landscape image batches automatically
mask_invalid_to_nans: replace invalid entries in a PyTorch tensor with NaN values using a validity mask
